output.summary: A rooted aquatic perennial native to most of Europe except Ireland and Scandinavia, temperate Asia, and locally Algeria. It has nearly circular floating leaves with wavy edges and clusters of yellow, fringe-edged flowers. Outside its native range, it can form dense mats and is considered a noxious weed in many regions.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves and flowers are cooked as a potherb; stem interiors are eaten, and seeds are ground for culinary use.
